arguments.command: ls -la /work/submit/ && echo "--- total size: $(du -sh /work/submit | cut -f1), entries: $(find /work/submit | wc -l)" && echo "--- symlinks/special files: $(find /work/submit -type l -o -type p -o -type b -o -type c -o -type s | wc -l)" && echo "--- Makefile:" && cat /work/submit/Makefile && echo "--- compile with strict warnings, default flags:" && make -C /work/submit clean >/dev/null && make -C /work/submit 2>&1 | grep -E "warning|error" | head; echo "warnings: none (rc=$?)"
